verdict.rationale: The evidence covers rate limiting, caching, fallbacks, dynamic routing, logging, and DLP, but nowhere describes minting gateway-managed keys per team/app that hide raw provider keys — the closest is unified billing/API access (docs-26, docs-40), which does not address key issuance or key exposure. Missing for 10: any mention of virtual/gateway-managed key creation, team/app-scoped key issuance, or key-hiding from provider credentials.
